verdict.summary: PR #367 is blocked because the trusted exact-head evidence does not prove the reconciliation ancestry and tree identity required by issue #366.

blockingFindings.title: Required reconciliation provenance is unverified
blockingFindings.details: For marius-patrik/DarkFactory PR #367 at base 13c4b96d16410dfb6cf108f50c32bce763540d91 and head d685adb0e59a01f7aca44842877010b227c98c01, the receipt claims that commit 6776b7b2cc815ec33f9094f95eefbb960d60bf1c preserves both protected histories and has tree 8bfa377804252df266444b1b1440d6736b59e07e, but the trusted verified state supplies neither commit-parent evidence nor tree-identity evidence. Issue #366 requires both histories to be preserved with only the listed semantic resolutions, and the receipt itself marks this evidence as requiring exact-head runtime verification. Obtain trusted exact-head proof of the reconciliation commit's parents, its tree identity with the protected dev base, and its ancestry in the current head; until then the acceptance criterion and provenance are unobservable rather than satisfied.

nonBlockingNotes: Trusted evidence confirms the exact fetched diff passes git diff --check and that neither base nor head contains gitlinks.
Execution results for npm run check are owned by the separate exact-head Validate gate and their omission from this review context is not itself a finding.
